cases.title: Assassination of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
cases.source_title: National Archives HSCA report on the assassination of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.
cases.source_metadata_note: The House Select Committee report records that Dr. King was on the balcony at approximately 6:01 PM on April 4, 1968 when the fatal shot was fired. That gives a strong event-time anchor for a public political homicide chart.
